description_en: Enables public network access for a specified Bastionhost instance
description_zh: 打开指定堡垒机实例公网访问开关
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost enable-instance-public-access --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: EnableInstancePublicAccess

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation to query the Bastionhost instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance
parameters.name: region_id

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of the Bastionhost instance for which public network access is enabled
InstanceId.description_zh: 已开启公网访问开关的堡垒机的实例ID

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. The China Chinese system generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
